description: Source code for redis-check-rdb, a utility to verify Redis RDB files for integrity and correctness.

methods.name: rdbShowGenericInfo
methods.description: Displays statistics about keys read, expired, and already expired during RDB check.

methods.name: rdbCheckError
methods.description: Logs an error message with context about the RDB file and current state.

methods.name: rdbCheckInfo
methods.description: Prints informational messages during RDB checking.

methods.name: rdbCheckSetError
methods.description: Sets an internal error message for RDB check errors.

methods.name: rdbCheckHandleCrash
methods.description: Handles crashes during RDB checking, logs error, and exits.

methods.name: rdbCheckSetupSignals
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers for crash detection during RDB check.

methods.name: redis_check_rdb
methods.description: Main function to check the integrity of an RDB file, returns 0 if sane, 1 if corrupted.

methods.name: checkRdbVersion
methods.description: Generates version string including Git info for the Redis build.

methods.name: redis_check_rdb_main
methods.description: Main entry point for redis-check-rdb utility, handles command-line arguments and initiates RDB check.
